description: The owner approved head A by comment at 10:00 and the workflow labeled and recorded it; B was pushed at 12:00; the owner reviewed B, removed the label and applied it again by hand. The shared token makes that read as a rerun of the 10:00 command, which approve_gate.py would accept, so the label needs a head record for B: refused.
